description: Start streaming logcat from the resolved target to a background buffer. Returns a processId - pass it to stop_log_capture to retrieve everything captured and end the stream.

filterSpec.description: adb logcat filter-spec, e.g. "MyApp:D *:S" to show only MyApp debug+ logs.

packageId.description: If given, filters to this package's PID via --pid (resolved at capture start, not re-resolved on app restart).

name: start_log_capture
title: Start Log Capture
